title: Khichdi with Indian Flair
description: A flavorful and comforting Indian-inspired khichdi dish made with tender rice and spices. This easy recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin and turmeric powder, and sauté for 1-2 minutes.
Add rice and khichdi, and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and cover the pan.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked.
Add salt to taste, and mix well.
Garnish with tender green beans or peas, if desired.
Serve hot, garnished with jammy chutney if desired.
